comment: The parts of the reply card a run only sometimes has anything to put in, added to the card the
first time it does rather than sitting empty on every card: an element the card carries is
space the card gives up, and most runs write no todo list and are interrupted by nobody.
Where each one goes is decided in FeishuCardElements, which also sets the ids the run streams
into — so a deployment replacing this file is free to restyle these elements and nothing else.
'queued' holds what the user said while the run was working, one quoted line per message, and
goes above the answer so the card reads in the order things were said: the message Feishu
quotes above the card, then this, then the reply. 'todo' is the run's task list, under the
answer. 'usage' is what the turn has cost, in the card's footer. This key is ignored.
reply-card.json keeps the elements every run writes to — the answer, the stop button, the
footer divider and the conversation hint — and those are the anchors these are placed against.
